look_here_first: Start with life cycle and the bracts. Texas paintbrush is an annual, usually with bright red to orange-red showy bracts and a more compact spring-flowering habit than the perennial prairie paintbrushes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: upper leaves/bracts brightly red to orange-red

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: showy color comes mainly from bracts rather than petals

lookalikes.differences: C. purpurea and C. lindheimeri are perennial. C. indivisa is the annual Texas paintbrush and usually looks more compact and uniformly scarlet-red.
